overlay.name: Humanizer
examples: Humanize this blog post draft: keep every fact, but cut the AI tells and make it sound like me.
Review this cover letter for signs of AI writing and list each one with a plainer rewrite.
Rewrite this product announcement so it reads like a person wrote it, without the sales language.

zh-CN.name: Humanizer 英文去 AI 味
zh-CN.description: 改写读起来像 AI 写的英文文本，让它像作者本人写的，同时不改变原意。面向英文；中文文本请用 Humanizer-zh。
examples: 帮这篇英文博客草稿去掉 AI 味：事实一个不改，读起来要像我自己写的。
检查这封英文求职信里有哪些 AI 写作痕迹，逐条列出并给出更朴素的改法。
把这篇英文产品发布稿改得像真人写的，去掉推销腔。
